# Premansh Panigrahi

> Portfolio of Premansh Panigrahi — web designer, branding expert, developer, video editor, UI/UX specialist, vibe coder, and future doctor.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, about, certifications, featured work, and contact.
- [Projects](/projects): Archive of selected case studies in design, branding, development, and direction.

## Selected case studies

- [Lumen Atelier](/projects/lumen-atelier): Identity and site for a Paris-based lighting studio.
- [Nocturne FM](/projects/nocturne-fm): After-hours radio platform with live waveform rituals.
- [Salt & Stone](/projects/salt-and-stone): Brand film for a coastal ceramics house.
- [Vitals](/projects/vitals-dashboard): Clinical-grade dashboard for solo medical practices.
- [Maison Noire](/projects/maison-noire): E-commerce flagship for a slow-fashion atelier.
- [Kintsugi OS](/projects/kintsugi-os): Reflective journaling system for medical students.
